items.title: 71231_Sam Wooding Oral History Interview
items.q: if they got a red hot John came in there, they would come down and say, get a piano player, a professor.

ctx.x: We're up there, see. Now, we used to come down there to play a little piano. So, in Atlantic City, the only way I could make a living, I used to, to eat and sleep, after trying to be a little pimp or something around there. See, was to stand on the corner of North Carolina and Baltic and, up North Carolina Avenue, going towards the beach, were the white bawdy houses. And going south from Arctic Avenue, Baltic Avenue, was the black bawdy houses, you see. Well, we used to stand on the corner, and when, if they got…
